title: You Think Consciousness Multitasks, Yet Your Brain Broadcasts Only One Thought at a Time
description:
You think your conscious mind runs your whole brain! Yet reading one short text makes a podcast vanish! This is the true story of Bernard Baars's Global Workspace Theory. Here is what went wrong with the myth of multitasking.
